'''Teva''' was a [[Shienaran]] friend of [[Hurin]].

==Activities==
Hurin refers to Teva as someone that got so mad at a hornet that he kicked the nest. This is in the way of advice to Rand to not anger the [[Cairhien]] nobles by burning their invitations.{{ref/book|2|25}}
